sections.heading: Game Modes and Features
sections.body:
World of WarTanks features a range of game modes and features, including:

Single-player campaign: This mode allows players to complete a series of missions and challenges, unlocking new tanks and upgrades as they progress.

Multiplayer: This mode allows players to compete against each other in 5 vs 5 team battles. Players can join or create a team, and compete against other teams in a series of matches.

Survival: This mode pits players against a series of increasingly tough enemies, with a focus on staying alive and accumulating as much damage as possible.

Leaderboards: This feature allows players to compete against each other in a series of challenges and tournaments, with a focus on accumulating points and rewards.

Achievements: This feature allows players to earn rewards and badges for completing specific challenges and achievements.

In-game store: This feature allows players to purchase premium content, including new tanks, upgrades, and power-ups.
